sections.title: Headline
sections.content: Agent infrastructure dominates today's GitHub momentum: memory, orchestration, agent-native CLIs, harnesses, and software-development skills occupy much of the top tier. Python is the leading language in the snapshot, while TypeScript and Go show up in supporting application and orchestration layers.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agent infrastructure, AI engineering and deployment, productivity surfaces, and cross-platform developer tooling dominate. Python appears in 7 of 12 repositories; TypeScript in 2; Go, Shell, and Vue in 1 each.

sections.title: Notable Shifts
sections.content: The strongest shift is toward agent systems as software infrastructure rather than isolated model demos: memory, harnesses, orchestration runtimes, agent-native CLIs, and development methodologies occupy the leading positions.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: GitHub attention is concentrating on the operational layer around AI agents: making them remember, coordinate, use existing software, and ship reliably. The signal is more about agent-enabling tooling than a single new model.
